about: Start-up items almost every US business has, with the cost only where an official page states it. Everything else says to check your state, city or current rates.

items.name: EIN (business tax number) from the IRS
items.note: Free from the IRS in minutes. Never pay a website for one.
items.says: Use this tool to get an EIN directly from the IRS in minutes for free. Beware of websites that charge for an EIN. You never have to pay a fee for an EIN.

items.name: Business registration and local license
items.note: Fees vary by state, county and city. Check your state and city before your first job.
items.says: The requirements and fees vary based on your business activities, location, and government rules.

items.name: Card payments app (Square Free or Stripe)
items.note: No monthly fee on the standard plans. You pay a fee on each card payment instead.
items.says: With Square Free, there are no monthly subscription costs. Stripe: no setup fees, monthly fees, or hidden fees.

items.name: Google Business Profile
items.note: Free to create. It's how people nearby find you on Google Search and Maps.
items.says: Yes, creating a Business Profile and listing your business on Google is free.

items.name: Separate business checking account
items.note: Check current rates. It keeps business money apart, which makes taxes and your books simpler.
items.says: For most small businesses, the business checking account is the main source of entries in the business books.
